name: Fileflows
description: FileFlows can drastically reduce your files, up to 90%, saving you space and money. No need to buy more hard drives, just shrink your files and start saving.
composeYaml:
services:
  fileflows:
    image: revenz/fileflows:latest
    environment:
      - _APP_URL=${APP_URL}
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - 'TZ=${TZ:-America/Toronto}'
    volumes:
      - 'fileflows_temp:/temp'
      - 'fileflows_configs:/app/Data'
      - 'fileflows_logs:/app/Logs'
      - 'fileflows_common:/app/common'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost:5000/api/system/version'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
